fusions.name: Skipping Links
fusions.desc: Your tongue hits the first enemy in its path up to 6 tiles away for 8 damage, then hops to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage. It holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Taut Line
fusions.desc: Stretches your tongue 6 tiles ahead of you for 3 seconds, dragging nearby enemies inward. It deals 12 damage to each one it catches and stuns it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Reeled Across
fusions.desc: Anchors your tongue on a spot up to 6 tiles away and reels you there instantly.

fusions.name: Slack Taken Up
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, 6 stamina comes back to you. Once every 5 seconds. Anything you strike moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.
